body.name: Multinomial truth regions
body.construction: For each \(n\in\mathbb N\), enumerate the same legal branch completions after substituting \(p=p_n(u)\), form the closed cells \(P_{n,v,b}\) with every incident equality face retained and empty cells discarded, and define \(D_{n,v}=\bigcup_bP_{n,v,b}=\{u\in\mathcal U_n:v\in\Lambda[\vartheta_{\mathrm{ASC}}\{p_n(u)\}]\}\) and \(\mathcal V_n(u)=\{v\in V:u\in D_{n,v}\}\). The component index is computational; \(\mathcal C_{n,\eta_0}\), \(H_{n,r_0}\), and \(M_n\) remain semantic-label objects.
